seo.pirateDescription: How to reach NO Anchor University (you cannot; it is a parody, and we are not sure where it is). A hackathon parody of IIT (ISM) Dhanbad.

original.title: Contact Information
original.lede: This is a parody website and cannot receive messages. Real contact details are on the official IIT (ISM) Dhanbad website.

pirate.title: Message in a Bottle
pirate.lede: We would love to hear from you, but this ship is a parody and we are not entirely sure where it is. Messages in bottles are read when found.

cards.title: B.Tech. Admission Office
lines: For queries regarding B.Tech. admission. Open from the morning bell to the evening bell on working days.

pirate.heading: Who you would write to
pirate.tagline: Every office is run by Gold D. Roger, so in a sense you only need one address. Unfortunately, it is a bottle.

cards.title: B.Tech admissions
lines: Every B.Tech question goes here. Open from the morning bell to the evening bell, except during storms.

cards.title: The Captain
lines: Gold D. Roger. Usually on the bridge, occasionally up the mast.

cards.title: The Quartermaster
lines: Gold D. Roger, surrounded by ship’s papers.

cards.title: Crew welfare
lines: Gold D. Roger, who also asks that you look after each other.

cards.title: Recruiters
lines: Gold D. Roger, who would like to talk about internships.

cards.title: The Map Room
lines: Gold D. Roger, and six copies of every map.

cells: From the morning bell to the evening bell
From the second bell to the last bell

pirate.heading: When the ship is staffed
pirate.caption: Working hours

cells: Morning bell to evening bell, with lunch when the galley says so

pirate.note: Security never sleeps. We checked at 3 AM.

original.heading: Address
paragraphs: NO Anchor University occupies an island campus whose position depends on the tide. This is a parody website and has no postal address.

pirate.heading: Where the ship is
paragraphs: Our address changes with the tide, so post tends to arrive late, or in a different ocean. This ship is a parody, so there is no real address. Bottles welcome; we cannot promise to find them.

aside.label: Navigator’s note
aside.text: Looking for the real institute this parody is based on? Its official website has the details.
